method: Exact contiguous AST, tokenizer, parser, writer and StringUtils::hasPrefix blocks; standard includes/macros/enclosures plus capture-only ParseError adapter and test harness. No full SDK, exception formatting, JSON, resolution or scientific backend execution.
input_policy: First198 inputs are all noncomment/nonempty positive then negative upstream grammar lines unchanged, followed by40 independent named/Unicode/charge/numeric/CV/annotation branch cases (including empty input). Every input goes through both source grammars; expected results come only from the executed C++ probe.
assertions: Both successful lossless and canonical source writer bytes
Rejected syntax error code, byte position and original message transported unchanged from parser throw site
limitations: Capture-only exception adapter replaces SDK exception infrastructure; no original exception formatting/global-handler behavior is executed.
This probes exact tokenizer/parser/AST/writer blocks and exact hasPrefix helper, not a full C++ SDK or chemistry resolution/mass/spectra/JSON backends.
Documented native Unicode field/decimal-underflow/overflow/resource boundaries remain separate; this finite fixture does not establish all-input parity.
